r.notes: There are two koalas in adjacent E.prava. Both are large and one was grunting. They must be experiencing the worst drought of this century with countless of their food trees dying off and most looking parched and stressed evidenced by leaf drop and dry leaves on the trees, epicormic growth is dying off and suckers and small trees are dying in huge numbers. I am seeing many more animal print at the dam's edges  than usual, including koala prints, indicating that they are suffering from thirst and coming to drink there.
